'''2014 World Championship Reset Beta''' was a post-reset ([[Open]]) side event at the [[2014 World Championship]] in Toronto, Ontario, 21–24 August 2014. [[Keith Brown]] finished 1st. The main championship used [[Legacy Open]].<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Toronto, Ontario
* '''Dates:''' 21–24 August 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Keith Brown]]
